name: Register Student Account
goal: Student creates a new account so that they can log in and use the platform.

name: Login Student
goal: Student authenticates with email and password to gain access to their personal workspace.

name: Search Lectures
goal: Student searches the catalogue to find lectures that match their interests.

name: View Lecture Details
goal: Student views the description, price and other metadata of a selected lecture.

name: Purchase and Enroll in Lecture
goal: Student pays for a lecture and becomes enrolled so that they can watch it later.

name: Watch Lecture (Playback)
goal: Student watches a lecture video and can resume from the last watched position on a later visit.

name: Upload Lecture Video
goal: Instructor uploads a video file for a lecture and makes it available to students.

name: View Enrollment Statistics
goal: Instructor checks how many students are enrolled in each of their lectures.

name: View Revenue Statistics
goal: Instructor reviews the revenue generated by each of their lectures.

name: Remove Inappropriate Lecture
goal: Administrator removes a lecture that violates policy from public view.
